title: raw parade and undo polish

commit.merge_subject: merge: raw parade and undo polish

description:
Owner answers #9/#10/#11 — undo/redo polish, three parts.

Capacity: GradeHistory.MAX_ENTRIES 50 -> 101. The KDoc now
states the convention the owner flagged precisely: MAX_ENTRIES
counts STATES, not undo STEPS — 101 states = the initial bottom
plus 100 recorded steps = exactly 100 servable undos (the
requested budget), because undo returns the grade to APPLY and
the initial state is a state to BE, not a step to take past.
New boundary tests pin it: 100 recorded steps serve exactly 100
undos (the 100th lands on the initial grade, the 101st returns
null), and the drop-oldest edge is pinned AT the capacity —
the record that fills the stack keeps the initial state, the
next one pushes it off and undo bottoms out one step shallower.
The existing overflow test now reads capacity-generic (its
'newest 50' comment was stale).

Icons: ic_undo/ic_redo replaced with the OFFICIAL Material
